courseName: RRB JE Mechanical Engineering Mock Test

questions.question: Reasoning Puzzle #51: In a seating alignment of 76 candidates facing North, Priya is ranked 11th from left. Simultaneously, a runner travels 105 km North, turns East 154 km, then South 105 km. What is Priya's rank from right and runner's net displacement?
questions.hint: Rank from right = Total (76) - Left (11) + 1 = 66th. North/South movements cancel, leaving 154 km East.
